summary: Redeem's verified path ignores quarantine — a recovered chain re-admits a quarantine-admitted ticket
description: Pre-existing gap found by TKT-73's adversarial review (R2), verified at HEAD: Redeem checks quarantine only inside degradedScan; the verified path (postgres.go:263-282) checks lifecycle_events alone. A ticket that took its one degraded admission under a verifier bug (ADR-021 §D6) gets admitted a SECOND time once the chain verifies clean again (e.g. the bad verifier build is reverted) — violating §D6's admit-once. Fix: the verified redemption path must consult the quarantine table under the ticket lock and deny every later DISTINCT occurrence (DecisionIntegrityQuarantined, original admitted_at); occurrence identity is checked BEFORE the quarantine denial (ADR-025 §D3) — a retry carrying the occurrence id that took the one degraded admission returns its original result, no second admission, no second alarm. ADR-025 §D2 names this: admission decisions consult trace ∪ quarantine, not the trace alone. Tests: broken-chain retry (same occurrence → original result), recovered-chain retry (same occurrence → original result), and degraded admission → restore verification → DISTINCT occurrence is denied — through both paths. Seams: lifecycle_smoke_test.go.

comments.body:
<!-- sdlc:stage=backlog kind=summary -->
Incidental finding from TKT-73 ai-review pass 2 (gpt-5.6-sol adversarial review), triaged out of the docs-only PR as pre-existing code scope. ADR-025 §D2 and amended ADR-003 §D2 carry the decision rule this must implement.

<!-- sdlc:stage=ready kind=claim -->
Claimed. Selection reason: highest-severity Ready ticket — a verified §D6 admit-once violation on the admission path (a quarantine-admitted ticket re-admits once the chain recovers). No open blockers; branch TKT-89-redeem-verified-quarantine off origin/main. Not risk:low (security/admission path) — plan gate applies. Note: ticket skipped formal shaping (no readiness/context-mémo); governing ADRs are named inline (ADR-021 §D6, ADR-025 §D2/D3, ADR-003 §D2) and will be re-resolved at plan time.

<!-- sdlc:stage=planning kind=plan -->
Plan drafted by gpt-5.6-sol (codex task 019f6fec, read-only). Full draft summary:

**Objective:** verified Redeem path consults lifecycle_events ∪ lifecycle_integrity_quarantine under the existing ticket FOR UPDATE lock (postgres.go:237). Quarantine checked after verifyTicketChain succeeds, BEFORE the redeemed-event lookup.

**Behavior on quarantine hit:** Accepted=false, DecisionIntegrityQuarantined, OccurredAt=quarantine admitted_at, one alarm via existing oweAlarm (mirrors degradedScan lifecycle.go:385-394), commit before return. Only sql.ErrNoRows continues to the trace lookup; any other error aborts — never falls through to appendLifecycle.

**Precedence:** quarantine row wins over an existing redeemed event (AlreadyRedeemed would hide the degraded admission and suppress §D6 escalation).

**Files:** postgres.go (Redeem + comment), lifecycle_smoke_test.go (3 tests). No migration, no schema change, no canonical-form change.

**Tests:** (1) extend TestCorruptChainAdmitsOnceThenQuarantines — retry OccurredAt = original, no redeemed event; (2) TestQuarantineDenialConvergesAcrossBrokenAndRecoveredChains — capture entry_hash, corrupt, degraded admit, deny while broken, restore exact bytes, VerifyLifecycle green as positive control, verified-path deny with original timestamp, 3 alarms total; (3) TestQuarantineWinsOverGrandfatheredRedeemedEvent — clean redeemed + inserted quarantine row → quarantined decision, quarantine timestamp, redeemed count stays 1.

**Non-goals:** occurrence-id protocol (TKT-84/85), quarantine schema widening, same-occurrence replay success, deterministic redeemed-id change.

<!-- sdlc:stage=plan-review kind=summary -->
Adversarial critique by main-agent (claude-fable-5) — planReview per config; drafter was gpt-5.6-sol (pair distinct).

Verified against HEAD 987ee5f: every named file/symbol/seam exists (Redeem postgres.go:237, degradedScan+oweAlarm+organizerMode lifecycle.go, corruptChain/VerifyLifecycle/countRows in lifecycle_smoke_test.go, TestCorruptChainAdmitsOnceThenQuarantines already asserting the 2-alarm sequence, quarantine columns ticket_id/organizer_id/reason/admitted_at). No hallucinated seams.

Verdicts: ACCEPT objective, DoD, file list, precedence rule (quarantine > AlreadyRedeemed — grounded in ADR-025 §D2 union + §D6 escalation), alarm-per-denial (matches existing degraded-path behavior; the no-second-alarm replay exception is explicitly occurrence-id-gated, TKT-84/85), error discipline (only ErrNoRows = absence), test plan incl. exact-bytes restore + VerifyLifecycle positive control.

AMEND (minor): (a) test 2 must capture entry_hash at sequence=1 BEFORE corruptChain and restore with the same trigger-disable/enable discipline — pin the mechanics; (b) accepted cost: +1 PK-indexed quarantine lookup on every verified scan — negligible, note it in the PR; (c) precedence test's inserted quarantine row must respect the append-only trigger (INSERT is allowed; never UPDATE).

REJECT: nothing. Pre-mortem lens: the risk register already covers the failure modes I'd have raised (fall-through after alarm error, commit-before-return, reason drift, false-recovery test).

<!-- sdlc:stage=planning kind=plan-final -->
Final plan = draft + amendments (a)-(c) above. No structural changes from the draft.

Two judgment calls baked in, for Gate 2 attention: (1) every verified-path quarantine denial owes a FRESH alarm (consistent with today's degraded path; replay dedup arrives with occurrence ids in TKT-84/85); (2) quarantine precedence over DecisionAlreadyRedeemed.

Introduced at plan-review, reviewed by no second model: none.

<!-- sdlc:stage=coding kind=summary -->
Implemented by main-agent (claude-fable-5) per approved plan-final. TDD: 3 tests written first and observed red (recovered-chain scan Accepted:true/accepted; already_redeemed hiding the quarantine), then the union check added to Redeem (postgres.go): quarantine consulted after verifyTicketChain, before the redeemed lookup, under the existing ticket FOR UPDATE; deny = DecisionIntegrityQuarantined + original admitted_at + one oweAlarm + commit; only ErrNoRows falls through. Diff: +161/-0, 2 files. Full store smoke suite green standalone; full `make check` green. PR #60.

<!-- sdlc:stage=ai-review kind=summary -->
Adversarial review by gpt-5.6-sol (codex adversarial-review, branch diff vs origin/main, session 019f6ff7). Verdict: APPROVE, no material findings. It verified: same-ticket serialization via the ticket FOR UPDATE; no cross-ticket lock conflicts; every quarantine/mode/alarm/append/commit error returns immediately (no fall-through to appendLifecycle); deferred-rollback-after-commit harmless; precedence and repeated alarms match documented policy; the recovery test restores genuine persisted hash bytes and independently verifies the chain before exercising the verified path.

Caveat noted per codex-runner.md: the run loaded a local unrelated review skill (known hijack); findings are concrete and code-cited, so the run counts as conclusive.

Second-pass call: NOT run — zero findings, zero fixes, the diff is unchanged since the reviewed SHA (6e65aa0). Ball to the human: review + merge PR #60 (Gate 3).

<!-- sdlc:stage=po-review kind=summary -->
Validation note — COS from the ticket, each proven by a real-Postgres test on the merged code (PR #60, merged 2026-07-17 12:12Z):
- Verified path consults quarantine under the ticket lock, denies with DecisionIntegrityQuarantined + original admitted_at: TestQuarantineDenialConvergesAcrossBrokenAndRecoveredChains (corrupt -> degraded admit -> restore exact bytes -> VerifyLifecycle green -> verified-path denial, no redeemed event, 3 alarms).
- Broken-chain retry returns the original result: extended TestCorruptChainAdmitsOnceThenQuarantines (original timestamp, no redeemed event).
- Both paths covered; quarantine wins over a grandfathered redeemed event: TestQuarantineWinsOverGrandfatheredRedeemedEvent (head does not advance).
Not user-demonstrable at a gate without a corrupted chain; code-level proof per pipeline rules. Occurrence-id retry dedup deliberately deferred to TKT-84/85 (ADR-025 §D3).
